name: GL_XFR_PSFT_INTERFACE
description: GL_XFR_PSFT_INTERFACE is a version of GL_INTERFACE used by the Peoplesoft Transform and Import program.  The Peoplesoft Transform and Import program takes raw data from GL_XFR_PSFT_RAW_INT, processes it, and moves any successfully processed data into GL_XFR_PSFT_INTERFACE.  It then launches Journal Import.
